facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: regulator directive concerning energy isolation at V-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on V-4110, PSV-4110 and PSV-4111 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on V-4110, PSV-4110 and PSV-4111 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. V-4110 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 12 December 2021 a regulatory notice was issued concerning V-4110, PSV-4110 and PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following start-up after maintenance.
